caption: The drawing features a detailed, oval-shaped brooch positioned toward the upper center of the page. The brooch is depicted in color, with a soft, light purple background and a thin gold or brass-colored rim. Inside the brooch, there is an intricately carved image of a bird holding a bouquet of flowers, rendered in shades of white and light gray, creating a cameo effect. To the right of the oval, there is a straight pin extending outward, indicating the pin mechanism of the brooch. Below the colored brooch, there are two smaller pencil sketches; one is a side view showing the convex shape of the brooch, and the other is a back view illustrating the pin and clasp mechanism. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, and the sketches are composed using fine lines and soft shading.
title: Brooch
